title: Page Insights reach and 3-second video viewer metrics removed on 2026-06-15
summary: By 2026-06-15, on all API versions, the Page/post reach metrics (page_impressions_unique, post_impressions_unique and their paid, viral, nonviral, organic and fan variants, the page_posts_impressions family, page_posts_served_impressions_organic_unique) and the 3-second viewer metrics (page_video_views_unique, post_video_views_unique) return an invalid metric error. SHAPI flags calls that request one of these metrics.
migrationNote: Switch reach and unique-viewer reporting to page_total_media_view_unique and post_total_media_view_unique (and page_media_view/post_media_view with is_from_ads for paid vs organic). The numbers use a different method, so do not splice them onto historical reach series, and drop metrics that have no replacement (viral/nonviral reach).

provenance.quote: By June 15, 2026, a number of the Page Insights metrics will be deprecated for all API versions. The API returns an invalid metric error when calling any of these metrics. Read our blog to learn more.
The following fields will be deprecated on June 15, 2026, and will no longer return results. We recommend you update your queries to use the replacements to continue to get data.
